items.title: Bid shading
clues: I only appear in some auctions.
I lower a bid toward the likely winning price.
items.why: Bid shading reduces overpaying in first-price auctions.

items.title: Pacing
clues: I keep a campaign from running out of money too early.
I spread a budget across the whole flight.
Too fast and the money is gone by lunch.
items.why: Pacing controls the speed of spend.

items.title: DMP
clues: Marketers use me to build audiences to target.
My name means data management platform.
items.why: A DMP organises audience data so buyers can target it.
